description: This file implements the control functions for a Transport Layer Security (TLS) connection controller, including starting the TLS handshake and closing the TLS session.

classes.name: PTLS_CONN_CONTROLLER_OBJECT
classes.description: The main TLS connection controller object that manages the TLS session and handshake state.

classes.name: PTLS_HAND_SHAKER_OBJECT
classes.description: Object responsible for performing the TLS handshake.

classes.name: PTLS_ALERT_HANDLER_OBJECT
classes.description: Object responsible for handling TLS alerts, such as session close notifications.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoStartHandshake(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initiates the TLS handshake process for the connection.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS TlsCcoCloseSession(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Closes the TLS session and sends a close notify alert.
